execution: Standard-library Python float64 reference evaluation. This evaluator does not compile or execute DWI-N1 GPU shaders; native integration has its own profile and evidence.
exactness: exact_sdf labels an analytic Euclidean distance formula in the declared coordinates, evaluated with finite floating-point arithmetic. It does not claim an exact biochemical model or exact machine arithmetic.
composition: All fields are checked separately. The boolean conjunction is not advertised as an exact SDF of the intersection. Boundary witnesses project onto one field only.

iupac_mechanism.title: IUPAC Gold Book: Michaelis-Menten mechanism
iupac_mechanism.supports: The explicit E+S reversible binding to ES, followed by regeneration of E and product formation. Pool hyperplanes are derived for this stated mechanism under additional closed-system assumptions.

iupac_kinetics.title: IUPAC Gold Book: Michaelis-Menten kinetics
iupac_kinetics.supports: Initial-rate equation v=V*S/(Km+S), parameter meaning and limited kinetic conditions; no actual enzyme constants supplied by this catalogue.

iupac_hh.title: IUPAC Gold Book: Henderson-Hasselbalch equation
iupac_hh.supports: The acid/base ratio relation. The catalogue's log-activity form follows the activity equilibrium definition; concentration substitution needs an additional activity approximation.

iupac_ph.title: IUPAC Gold Book: pH
iupac_ph.supports: pH is defined using hydrogen-ion activity, with experimental conventions and uncertainty.

iupac_acidity.title: IUPAC Gold Book: acidity constant
iupac_acidity.supports: Acid dissociation equilibrium and definition of Ka. Parameter pKa is illustrative unless replaced with an identified value at declared conditions.

nist_thermodynamics.title: NIST: Recommendations for Terminology and Databases for Biochemical Thermodynamics
nist_thermodynamics.supports: Distinguishes specific ionic species balances from transformed biochemical equations at fixed pH or other buffered conditions.

vulkan_budget.title: Khronos: VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryBudgetPropertiesEXT
vulkan_budget.supports: Budget and usage are driver estimates for heaps, not a promise of successful allocations. The example's inputs are authored values, not live device queries.

mathematical_provenance.halfspace: Orthogonal projection: d=(a dot x-b)/norm(a), nearest boundary x-d*a/norm(a).
mathematical_provenance.slab: For low<=a dot x<=high: d=(abs(a dot x-(low+high)/2)-(high-low)/2)/norm(a).
mathematical_provenance.authors_note: The metric bindings and analytic projection derivations are explicit implementation mathematics, not formulas attributed to the chemical terminology sources. See docs/DOMAIN_FIELDS.md.
